mapper.insert: MERGE INTO LIKES_CLASS lc USING (SELECT #{user_idx} AS LIKER_IDX, #{class_idx} AS CLASS_IDX FROM dual) src ON (lc.LIKER_IDX = src.LIKER_IDX AND lc.CLASS_IDX = src.CLASS_IDX) WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (LIKES_CLASS_IDX, LIKER_IDX, CLASS_IDX, CREATED_AT) VALUES (SEQ_LIKES_CLASS.NEXTVAL, src.LIKER_IDX, src.CLASS_IDX, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT c.COACH_IDX AS coach_idx, c.USER_IDX AS user_idx, c.NICKNAME AS nickname, c.INTRO AS intro, c.PHOTO AS photo, lu.CREATED_AT AS created_at FROM LIKES_USER lu JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_IDX = lu.LIKED_USER_IDX JOIN COACH c ON c.USER_IDX = u.USER_IDX WHERE lu.LIKER_IDX = #{user_idx} AND u.USER_TYPE = 'COACH' ORDER BY lu.CREATED_AT DESC

SELECT c.CLASS_IDX AS class_idx, c.TITLE AS title, c.INTRO AS intro, c.PHOTO AS photo, c.PRICE AS price, c.START_DATE AS startDate, c.END_DATE AS endDate, lc.CREATED_AT AS created_at, u.USER_NAME AS providerName FROM LIKES_CLASS lc JOIN CLASS c ON c.CLASS_IDX = lc.CLASS_IDX LEFT JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_IDX = c.PROVIDER_IDX WHERE lc.LIKER_IDX = #{user_idx} ORDER BY lc.CREATED_AT DESC
